step.cmd: Check in the third-party document as an offline agreement in X-Author Contracts. For more information, see Creating Offline Agreements.
Check out the offline agreement document.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Intelligent Discovery. If you do not see Intelligent Discovery under the Work tab, click the More icon () and from the menu, select Intelligent Discovery.

postreq.p: Your document is sent for Intelligent Discovery. Under the Work tab, click the More icon () and click Review Import Result to check the status of Intelligent Discovery. You get a message and an email on Intelligent Discovery status.
Clicking Review Import Results changes the status of the agreement in Conga CLM. For more information on change of statuses in Conga CLM, see Status Changes in Offline Agreements.

After the Intelligent Discovery performs the data extraction successfully, you will receive an email. You can see the fields and clauses recognized from the document in X-Author Contracts Advanced.
